name: Sprocket
text: I'll dive into the `/prompts/` directory and audit the top 10 most-used prompts by execution count in `metrics.json`. Running `grep -r '"executions": [1-9][0-9]*' --include="*.json" ./prompts/ | sort -t: -k2 -nr | head -n 10 > top_prompts.txt` to extract them, then review each for redundancy or inefficiency. After that, I'll patch any safe optimizations (like trimming whitespace or consolidating similar templates) and log the changes in `CHANGES.md` with before/after diffs. Lead can then verify the artifact and declare done.

name: Gauge
text: Gauge: Hold—your grep regex `"executions": [1-9][0-9]*'` excludes single-digit counts and caps at 99, missing prompts with 100+ executions. Evidence? Run `jq '.executions' ./prompts/*/metrics.json | sort -n | tail -n 1` to expose the true ceiling. Also, `metrics.json` may not track *all* executions—only those logged in the last rotation window.
